title: 日本語の森 — 【日本の方言】日本人でもわからない？！北海道 vs 関西 vs 関東
description: A Nihongo no Mori lesson comparing regional dialects across three major Japanese regions: Hokkaido (北海道), Kansai (関西), and Kanto (関東). The teacher explains dialect features, vocabulary differences, and pronunciation variations in clear standard Japanese with on-screen text explanations. Designed for JLPT N3 learners aiming to understand regional variation and expand comprehension beyond standard Tokyo-dialect Japanese.
creator: 日本語の森 (Nihongo no Mori)
